rule: UI → command → owner → validation/permission → state/operation → event/receipt → projection → attribution → recovery/deep link

flows.ui_source: Settings manager Provider / Account / Model / Installation resource/detail action
validation_permission: secret redaction or FileSafe where applicable
flows.state_or_operation: Persistent setting mutation for requested policy; ObservableWork for external install/update/test/restore/cleanup; navigation-only for deferred Server insertion.
flows.event_receipt: Typed completion/failure event with deterministic operation/receipt identity and simulation marker in concept.
flows.ui_projection: Requested/effective state, stage progression, source/ownership evidence, failure, rollback, and last-known-good projection.
flows.usage_diagnostic_attribution: Attribute external invocation/test/update work to the owning provider/tool/runtime; pure local preview/navigation has no Usage charge.
flows.concept_simulation_boundary: The concept mutates isolated browser demo state only and never performs login, installation, filesystem, provider, container, backup, or remote operations.

flows.ui_source: Installation detail → Update from official source
flows.state_or_operation: ObservableWork stages update in isolation, verifies invocation/ownership, and restores prior version on failure.
flows.event_receipt: Update staged / verification failed / rollback completed receipts.
flows.ui_projection: Selected/shadowed identity, progress, failure reason, rollback availability, final readiness.
flows.usage_diagnostic_attribution: Provider/tooling installation diagnostics only; never provider token usage.
